_readme: This is the whole event. Nothing here is hard-coded in the app.
Agenda from the team briefing deck of 28 Oct 2026 (draft). Times marked
'to confirm' in a description were not in the deck and are best guesses.
Speakers are listed by role, not by name, because this file is committed
and the agenda is published on the preview site. Names can be added later.
Validated by src/lib/event-schema.ts. Tests use config/event.test.json,
a frozen copy of the earlier dummy agenda, so editing this file never

branding._readme: The dark teal theme from the event slide template (Telegraf style), with buttons and links in the blue from the event logo. Change the colours here and the whole portal follows, including the big screen. The brand block keeps the TNB colours. Telegraf is a licensed font and is not bundled: where it is installed it is used, otherwise the next font in the list is.

days.subtitle: Breakouts and group presentations. Dress code: smart casual. Sustain, strengthen, step up.

sessions.description: Identify root causes, priority interventions and 2027 initiatives.

sessions.title: Shaping our next S-curve: group presentations
sessions.description: Each group presents its priorities and proposed actions. Cut off at 5 pm.
